prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic editorial street portrait of an approved adult man walking outside a refined hotel or city building.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with neatly styled dark hair and trimmed beard, wearing a black long-sleeve polo, beige trousers, black leather shoes, sunglasses, a silver watch, and a beige jacket draped over one shoulder. He walks confidently with one hand in his pocket.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 rule-of-thirds framing with subject slightly right of center, dark doorway on left, warm stone facade, hotel plaque, and subtle architectural signage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight, moderate contrast, warm neutral palette, clean sophisticated street-fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial digital photography, vertical 4:5 framing, sharp subject, realistic wool, cotton, leather, metal, stone, and signage texture.
